mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS value, p.poi_name AS label FROM pms_poi p WHERE p.camp_id = #{campId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.poi_id ASC

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(rel.id, rc.room_category_id) AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(COALESCE(pr.poi_id, rc.poi_id) AS CHAR) AS channelStoreId, p.poi_name AS channelStoreName, COALESCE(rel.out_room_category_id, CONCAT('未关联-', rc.name)) AS channelRoomType, CASE WHEN rel.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE rc.name END AS linkedRoomType, rel.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, rel.audit_status AS auditStatus FROM room_category rc LEFT JOIN channel_room_category_rel rel ON rel.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND rel.camp_id = rc.camp_id
AND rel.account_id IN
#{accountId}
LEFT JOIN channel_poi_rel pr ON pr.account_id = rel.account_id AND pr.camp_id = rel.camp_id AND pr.poi_id = rc.poi_id JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = rc.poi_id AND p.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 AND ( rel.id IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM channel_room_category_rel existing WHERE existing.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND existing.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN rel.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC

SELECT log_rows.accountId, log_rows.channelId, log_rows.channelName, log_rows.accountName, log_rows.accountStatus, log_rows.accountAuthorizedAt, log_rows.accountUpdatedAt, log_rows.roomRelId, log_rows.outRoomCategoryId, log_rows.roomCategoryName, log_rows.shelfStatus, log_rows.auditStatus, log_rows.roomRelUpdatedAt FROM ( SELECT CAST(ca.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId, ca.channel_id AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, ca.account_name AS accountName, ca.status AS accountStatus, ca.authorized_at AS accountAuthorizedAt, ca.updated_at AS accountUpdatedAt, NULL AS roomRelId, NULL AS outRoomCategoryId, NULL AS roomCategoryName, NULL AS shelfStatus, NULL AS auditStatus, NULL AS roomRelUpdatedAt, COALESCE(ca.authorized_at, ca.updated_at) AS sortTime FROM channel_account ca WHERE ca.camp_id = #{campId} AND ca.status = 'authorized'
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(ca.account_id AS CHAR) AS accountId, ca.channel_id AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, ca.account_name AS accountName, ca.status AS accountStatus, ca.authorized_at AS accountAuthorizedAt, ca.updated_at AS accountUpdatedAt, CAST(rel.id AS CHAR) AS roomRelId, rel.out_room_category_id AS outRoomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, rel.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, rel.audit_status AS auditStatus, rel.updated_at AS roomRelUpdatedAt, rel.updated_at AS sortTime FROM channel_room_category_rel rel JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = rel.account_id AND ca.camp_id = rel.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rel.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = rel.camp_id WHERE rel.camp_id = #{campId} AND rel.shelf_status = 'on_shelf' AND rel.audit_status = 'approved' ) log_rows ORDER BY log_rows.sortTime DESC, log_rows.accountId ASC
